    c0=min(j for _,j in cells);c1=max(j for _,j in cells)
    R0,R1,C0,C1=r0-2,r1+2,c0-2,c1+2
    out=[[inner if R0<=i<=R1 and C0<=j<=C1 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i in range(r0,R1+1):
